class.name: PhysicsGetRestInfoResult3D
class.brief_description: Stores the nearest collision information of a shape query.
class.description: This class contains the collision data computed by [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D.get_rest_info_into]. If the shape collides with multiple objects, only the nearest collision is stored.

members.member: The shape index of the colliding shape.
The colliding object's velocity [Vector3]. If the object is an [Area3D], the result is [code](0, 0, 0)[/code].
The collision normal of the query shape at the intersection point, pointing away from the intersecting object.
